description: Labelled evaluation set for the Standard Insurance QA template. Use `php artisan qa:eval` to score.

cases.description: High-quality call: clear intro, full recording disclosure, structured discovery, accurate quote, cooling-off mentioned, clear close

segments.text: Hello, this is Sarah Mitchell from Clearview Life Insurance. Just to let you know, this call may be recorded for training and quality purposes.
Wonderful. I'm calling today because you recently submitted an enquiry about life insurance cover. Could you tell me your age and whether you have any dependants?
I'm thirty-eight. I have two kids, seven and nine.
Do you have any existing life insurance cover? And what monthly premium are you comfortable with?
No existing cover. Somewhere between thirty and fifty pounds a month.

Based on what you've told me, I'd suggest a level term policy for five hundred thousand pounds of cover over a twenty-five year term, at around thirty-two to thirty-six pounds a month. The final premium is subject to underwriting and is not guaranteed until the policy is issued.
Once the policy is issued, you have a fourteen-day cooling-off period where you can cancel and receive a full refund. There are no penalties for cancelling within that window.

The next step is I'll send you a summary email with all the details and a link to start the application. The underwriting team will follow up within two working days. Is there anything else you'd like to know today?
No, that all sounds great. Thank you Sarah.
Thank you for your time. Have a lovely day.

expected.notes: Agent states recording at S1: 'this call may be recorded for training and quality purposes'
Agent gives full name and company at the start of S1
Agent asks age, dependants, existing cover, budget across S3, S5
Quote given as range with 'not guaranteed' caveat in S7
Next steps explained in S10: summary email and underwriting timeline

cases.description: Weak call: skips recording disclosure, jumps straight to pitch, no budget discovery, no cooling-off

segments.text: Hi is this John? I'm calling from an insurance company. Are you interested in life insurance?
We have a really great policy, five hundred thousand pounds cover for only forty pounds a month. You just need to fill out a form and we can get you sorted today.
Sounds okay I guess. What happens if I want to cancel?
You can cancel anytime. Shall I send you the form?

expected.notes: No mention of call recording anywhere in the transcript
Agent only says 'I'm calling from an insurance company', no name given
Agent skips age, dependants, existing cover and budget — goes straight to pitch
Quote given as single fixed figure, no 'subject to underwriting' caveat
Agent only says 'cancel anytime' — 14-day statutory period never mentioned
Close is 'shall I send you the form' with no explanation of next steps
